description: Hand-written additions to the generated step2 catalog (no LLM). 'aliases' attach extra callee path:line identities to an existing translated rule (re-exports/toolchain line drift); 'rules' add contracts for monomorphic instances of unsafe APIs whose generic step2 translation failed or was never extracted. Applied by prepare_step2_catalog.py; rule ids become step2-supplement-<n>.

aliases.reason: ptr::copy_nonoverlapping re-exports the intrinsics function that MIRScan reports as the callee.

rules.name: unsafe fn get_unchecked (& self , index : usize) -> & T
rules.api: impl < T > [T] { unsafe fn get_unchecked (& self , index : usize) -> & T }
rules.rule: For safety, `index` must be in bounds for the slice when calling `get_unchecked` (instance `I = usize`); generic step2 rule-970 failed translation because `I` is opaque.

rules.name: unsafe fn get_unchecked_mut (& mut self , index : usize) -> & mut T
rules.api: impl < T > [T] { unsafe fn get_unchecked_mut (& mut self , index : usize) -> & mut T }
rules.rule: For safety, `index` must be in bounds for `self` when calling `get_unchecked_mut` (instance `I = usize`); generic step2 rule-971 failed translation because `I` is opaque.

rules.name: const unsafe fn from_size_align_unchecked (size : usize , align : usize) -> Self
rules.api: impl Layout { const unsafe fn from_size_align_unchecked (size : usize , align : usize) -> Layout }
rules.rule: `align` must be a non-zero power of two and `size`, rounded up to the nearest multiple of `align`, must not exceed `isize::MAX` (the preconditions of `Layout::from_size_align`, which step1 extracted no rule from).
